intro: Ten stories from the last day, rewritten in plain British English. Tap any word you don't know.

items.title: Trump says deportation policy was too tough
items.text: US President Donald Trump has said that his deportation policy was "too tough". He made the comments in an interview on the television programme 60 Minutes. The remarks suggest that a deal on immigration with the Democrats may be close. His party recently suffered a heavy defeat in the midterm elections. Critics say the change of tone shows how much pressure he is under.

gloss.deportation: the act of forcing a person to leave a country
gloss.midterm elections: US elections held halfway through a president's term
gloss.tone: the general feeling or attitude of what someone says

items.title: Drone strike causes blackout in Iraqi Kurdistan
items.text: A drone attack on a gas field in Iraqi Kurdistan has stopped gas production there. As a result, about 70 per cent of northern Iraq has been left without electricity. Engineers are trying to restore the supply. The strike came as tension rose across the region, where several attacks have been reported in recent days.

gloss.drone: an aircraft without a pilot, flown by remote control
gloss.gas field: an area where natural gas is taken from the ground
gloss.blackout: a time when there is no electricity
gloss.restore: to bring something back to how it was
gloss.tension: a feeling of worry between people or countries

items.title: Ten die as overcrowded car falls into Brazilian lake
items.text: An overcrowded car has plunged into a lake in Brazil, killing ten people. Five of the victims were children. The vehicle was carrying far more passengers than it should have. Rescue teams worked at the scene on Sunday. Local authorities have not yet said what caused the accident.

gloss.plunge: to fall suddenly and with force
gloss.victim: a person who is hurt or killed in an accident or crime
gloss.rescue team: a group of people who save others from danger
gloss.authorities: the officials who are in charge

items.title: Man Utd and Aston Villa draw 4-4 at Old Trafford
items.text: Manchester United and Aston Villa shared eight goals in a Premier League thriller on Sunday. Villa went 2-0 up inside a few minutes, but United hit back before half-time. Villa led 4-2 as the match went into stoppage time. Joshua Zirkzee scored to make it 4-3, then Patrick Dorgu headed an equaliser in the 96th minute. It was Unai Emery's 200th Premier League game.

gloss.hit back: to reply strongly after being attacked or losing ground
gloss.stoppage time: extra minutes added at the end of a match
gloss.equaliser: a goal that makes the score level
gloss.header: a goal or pass made with the head

items.title: Eight players set for ATP Finals in Turin
items.text: The field for the ATP Finals is now complete. Rafael Jodar took the last place after Carlos Alcaraz beat Taylor Fritz in Paris. Alexander Zverev, who is the new world number one, will play alongside Alcaraz, Ben Shelton and Daniil Medvedev. Jannik Sinner will miss the event through injury. The tournament runs from 15 to 22 November, and the draw is on Thursday.

gloss.field: the group of players who take part in a competition
gloss.qualify: to earn the right to take part
gloss.draw: the process that decides who plays whom
gloss.miss out: to not take part in something

items.title: AI beats doctors on complex diagnoses in study
items.text: A study in the journal Science says a Microsoft diagnostic AI system performed better than general doctors on difficult medical cases. The system gave the right answer in 83.2 per cent of cases. The doctors who took part managed 36.1 per cent. Researchers say the tool could help with hard-to-solve cases, but it has not replaced doctors.

gloss.diagnosis: the decision about what illness a person has
gloss.journal: a magazine that publishes scientific research
gloss.generalist: a doctor who treats many kinds of illness, not one speciality
gloss.perform: to do a task well or badly
gloss.replace: to take the place of someone or something

items.title: Stronger flu jab linked to lower Alzheimer's risk
items.text: Researchers have linked a stronger flu vaccine to a much lower risk of Alzheimer's disease. According to ScienceDaily, the risk was nearly 55 per cent lower in people who had the stronger jab. The result shows a link, not proof of cause and effect. Scientists say more research is needed to understand why it may happen.

gloss.flu jab: an informal British word for a flu vaccine injection
gloss.Alzheimer's disease: an illness that slowly destroys memory
gloss.cause and effect: when one thing makes another thing happen
gloss.risk: the chance that something bad will happen

items.title: New fish found in the Amazon may be endangered
items.text: Scientists have described a new species of fish in the Amazon. They say it may already be endangered. Many animals in the region are under pressure from changes to rivers and forests. The discovery shows how much of the Amazon is still unknown to researchers. The team hopes the finding will help protect the species.

gloss.species: a type of animal or plant
gloss.endangered: in danger of disappearing for ever
gloss.discovery: something found for the first time

items.title: GTA VI may launch with 55 single-player trophies
items.text: A new report says Grand Theft Auto VI may launch with 55 trophies and achievements for the single-player campaign. The information has not been confirmed by Rockstar Games. The game is now set to come out on 19 November 2026. Rockstar has apologised for the extra time, saying it needs it for polish. Fans are watching every small detail before the release.

gloss.trophy: a reward you unlock in a PlayStation game
gloss.campaign: the main story of a video game
gloss.polish: final improvements that make something smooth and clean
gloss.confirm: to say officially that something is true

items.title: GTA VI box lists 230 GB for PS5
items.text: A German PS5 box for Grand Theft Auto VI lists a file size of 230 GB. Rockstar had earlier asked players to free up as much as 212 GB. Players may need to delete other games to make room before launch. The release is planned for 19 November. Rockstar has not commented on the new figure.

gloss.free up: to make space or time available
gloss.file size: the amount of storage a file uses
gloss.comment: to give an opinion or statement
